subject: Draft: HelioPay integration story — fact check & quote approval
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@heliopay.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@heliopay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: HelioPay integration story — fact check & quote approval

Hi Sofia / Miguel —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Attached is the third draft of the short case narrative we discussed (helio_case_draft_v3.docx). The draft pulls in the usage stats and the quote your team approved in the call: “Redwood reduced per-query costs by ~42% while keeping latency within our 99th percentile SLOs.”

Can you please: 
- Confirm the stats callouts are accurate for Q3 (I attached usage_chart_Q3.png),
- Redline any language you don’t want published (I’ll accept tracked changes or a simple PDF), and
- Confirm the final short quote (one line) we can use in marketing.

If possible, a requested response by EOD Friday (Nov 20) would help our publishing schedule. I’ve looped in Marissa (customer marketing) to coordinate approvals and Monica (legal) will be on standby for redlines.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments (3): helio_case_draft_v3.docx (docx), usage_chart_Q3.png (image), NDA-scan.pdf (referenced)

From: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@heliopay.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@heliopay.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:33:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Draft: HelioPay integration story — fact check & quote approval

Hi Alex —

Great draft, thanks for sending. I shared the document with our comms team and they provided a few edits — attached as redlines (redlines_heliopay.pdf). High-level notes:

- The cost reduction figure is correct but can you soften the wording to say “up to 42%” rather than a flat number (we have some regional variance).
- The latency SLO line is accurate, but can we change 99th percentile to “p99” for consistency with our docs?
- Please remove any customer-specific transaction examples (the example on page 2 contains a masked merchant id but we prefer none).

Approved quote option (proposed): “Redwood lowered our inference cost while preserving p99 latency — enabling us to scale new endpoints.” — feel free to shorten.

We’ll get the redline PDF over to you by EOD today. We are good to be a reference partner; need final legal sign-off for publication.

Best,
Sofia Reyes
Head of Communications, HelioPay
sofia.reyes@heliopay.com

Attachment: redlines_heliopay.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@heliopay.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@heliopay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: HelioPay integration story — fact check & quote approval

Thanks Sofia — this is helpful.

Marissa / Monica — Sofia sent redlines and a suggested quote (see attached PDF). Two asks for you: 
1) Marissa — can you confirm the marketing copy length (we usually trim to 1 sentence for the site). Is the proposed quote above ok to publish as-is or should we shorten?
2) Monica — any legal flags from a typical reference release standpoint? They noted legal sign-off; I can route a short form release if that helps.

If both sign off, I’ll send back a final clean version and request a signature from HelioPay.

Alex

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: HelioPay integration story — fact check & quote approval

Alex / Marissa —

Reviewed the redlines. Legal is comfortable with the public-facing content once we: 
- Replace the flat "42%" with "up to 42%" (audit trail/logs retained in our notes),
- Accept the shorter quote (we should capture attribution as "— Head of Communications, HelioPay"),
- Remove merchant example and any transaction-level sample data.

I’ll draft a short two-paragraph reference release for signature (one-liner permission to publish + attribution). If HelioPay prefers a standard PDF release we can convert it. No additional indemnities requested.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: sample_release_short.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@heliopay.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: HelioPay integration story — fact check & quote approval

Love the draft, Alex. I agree with Monica on tone and the attribution. Marissa here (customer marketing) — two quick edits from a marketing POV: 
- Shorten the quote to this final one-line for the website: “Redwood lowered our inference cost while preserving p99 latency.”
- Can we add a short ROI stat line under the header: “Time-to-market for new endpoints reduced by 6 weeks” — Sofia, can you confirm that timing? If yes, we’ll include a small callout box.

If HelioPay confirms the time-to-market stat, I’ll get a design brief to the creative team and schedule a micro-case landing page. Otherwise proceed with the headline + quote only.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Alex / Marissa / Monica —

Thanks — we confirm: 
- Use "up to 42%" in the costs line.
- Change "99th percentile" to "p99".
- Confirmed quote (shortened): “Redwood lowered our inference cost while preserving p99 latency.”
- Time-to-market: confirmed internally as ~6 weeks for the endpoint referenced; ok to include the ROI line.

We prefer a short PDF release to sign. If you can send the two-paragraph release + one-line permission statement, I’ll route it through procurement/legal and loop Miguel for signature. Desired publishing window is the week of Dec 6 (post earnings quiet period for us).

Sofia
